scope: Fixed OD/time mechanism screen on previously exposed development dates
limitations: The screen uses static OD, schedule, July25 fit and public prefix receipts only.
Each bounded replay compares two fixed paths under an ideal local-departure event clock.
The forecast waiting witness uses nominal running times and fitted departure survival. The schedule-only waiting witness uses published future departure and arrival clocks.
Missing endpoints censor evaluation. No observed door-close, passenger reaction, or cancellation publication time.
Repeated windows within a date are dependent. This is developmental mechanism evidence.

reordering_sensitivity.scope: After the primary fixed OD screen, broaden the destination set using public direct-trip paths only.
